_doc: Drydock RO-2 witness (docs/governance/harbor-ro2-identity-seam.md § The witness): every id-grammar copy and spelling-derived parent outside the identity seam (src/gzkit/core/models.py, src/gzkit/core/id_resolver.py), seeded 2026-10-18 by `gz validate --id-seam` at tranche 1. Keyed by file, enclosing symbol and kind, never line. Kinds: ADR, OBPI, REQ, TASK (a regex literal or pattern= keyword encoding that grammar; tranches 2-4), parent (a split, slice or prefix rewrite of an id; tranche 5), compose (an id-shaped f-string composing an id from parts, a parent recovery or a child-prefix scan; tranche 5). A shrink-ratchet: rows only leave or lower, and RO-2 closes when 'sites' is empty.
